title: nerv-planner-v1: model-layer cases on Misato's own tool index, Italian and English
goal: A model is given nerv's real tool index and its decision is checked, so a model change or a tool-index change is measured
acceptance: Owner decision 2026-11-26 in chat: "ok to all" (accepts proposal from solution:F-016, docs/reviews/2026-11-shared-assets/gauntlet-nerv.md); same message: "nerv and all modules will need to work with Italian".
evals/gauntlet/nerv-planner-v1.json exists: model layer, regression and holdout splits, invented data, exact-json on the action and its arguments (json-match once gauntlet-protocol releases it)

Cases cover reminders (relative times counted from when the owner asked, as in B-143), memory facts, a write tool proposed for approval, a switched-off pack's tool never chosen, and an unknown request answered with reply or ask; each as an Italian and an English request over the real tool list (src/misato.ts:123-129), e.g. "ricordami tra due ore di chiamare Marco", "ricordami domani alle 9 di pagare la bolletta", "stampa i piedi di Smoke", "controlla la mail di oggi"
A test fails when a case names a tool the index does not register
First owner-approved run recorded in evals/gauntlet/ledger.json (human action; never commit ledger changes from local test runs)
Feeds F-126, F-106, F-113 (before and after), B-143, F-082, F-083, F-121 and F-132
privacy: Neutral invented data only; no secrets, tokens, private channel IDs or personal data in Git.
escalation: The first model run and any --allow-models run need the owner (human action); a material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: From solution:F-016-T03 proposal 1; Italian phrasings are part of every case set (owner 2026-11-26): each capability has Italian and English requests. 0.25 h owner for the first run. Not a measurement.
